run_model_forward: run the forward pass of a loaded model on a forward batch and return logits output
load_model_weights: load model weights from disk or remote source into the model runner
update_model_weights_from_disk: update model weights in-place from disk without reloading the entire model
sample_next_tokens: sample next token ids from logits output using the configured sampler
update_weights_distributed: update model parameters online via a distributed process group for RLHF workflows
